# Leech and Cloze Pill Cards

@card #leech-candidate
@front
What is the mechanism of action of fluoroquinolones (e.g., ciprofloxacin)?
@back
Inhibition of bacterial **DNA gyrase** (topoisomerase II) and **topoisomerase IV**, preventing DNA replication.
@end

@card
The 50S ribosomal subunit is inhibited by {{c1::macrolides}} and {{c2::clindamycin}}.
@end
